Placeholder, tracked in [#62](https://github.com/UBC-DSCI/reproducible-and-trustworthy-workflows-for-data-science/issues/62).

Documenting a Python package with [Great Docs](https://posit-dev.github.io/great-docs/),
which builds a documentation site, rendered with Quarto,
from the package's docstrings, README and command-line interface:

- adding it to a uv project (`uv add --dev great-docs`)
- `great-docs init`, which writes the `great-docs.yml` configuration
- `great-docs build` and `great-docs preview`
- publishing the site with GitHub Pages (`great-docs setup-github-pages`)

The quartodoc version is in the Archive as
[Package documentation: Python (quartodoc)](9560-package-documentation-python-quartodoc.qmd).
